name: Lau mam U Minh
summary: Lẩu mắm U Minh is the fermented-fish hotpot of the melaleuca forest, shared with fish and forest greens in the pot. One recipe adds shrimp, squid, and lemongrass; another cooks freshwater fish in coconut water.
culture: Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam reports that Vietkings recorded the largest U Minh pot at the 2022 Hương rừng U Minh festival.
howToEat: Phòng Văn hóa Thông tin huyện Ngọc Hiển and Vietnam Airlines start the pot with mắm cá sặc and chopped lemongrass, then add fish, shrimp, squid, and the greens đọt nhãn lồng, rau đắng, càng cua, bông súng, and đọt choại.
Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam uses mắm sặt with freshwater fish and coconut water, a green list that includes hẹ nước, and says to eat it hot over embers.
where: U Minh Hạ, or back in Cà Mau city.
seoTitle: Lau mam U Minh — fermented fish hotpot
seoDescription: Lẩu mắm U Minh is the fermented-fish hotpot of the melaleuca forest, with fish and forest greens in the pot. Two published recipes differ.
